<div style="font-size:250%;">Scatter '''Analytics'''</div>
<span style="font-size:125%;">A collection of projects and services to improve the resiliency of the information ecosystem.</span>
</div>

==Goals==
* Analytics = Metrics + Direction
* Metrics ''with constructive feedback'' for improving wikis and online information
* Know what is cited in Wikipedia and where
* Build a chain of provenance from Wikipedia to Wikipedia's sources to the sources' sources
* Understand the relative, contextual reliability of sources

==Adding projects to this list==
Your project does not need to be developed by Scatter LLC to be on this list if it is open source and furthers the above stated goals. The goals of this project require extensive collaboration.
